start_pr.title: 11000151: reviewed Artin A5 fixed-generator classification (4/5)
start_pr.body:
This resolves Wajnryb’s fixed-generator quotient question under both explicit equivalence conventions. Positive words in the five standard generators representing c² in B6/<<c h⁻¹>> have lengths20/30/40, with1/1/2 strict Hurwitz classes; simultaneous conjugation merges the two length40 classes and gives the proposed three representatives. Arbitrary conjugate-factor inputs are outside the statement. Original author status claimed_solved,4/5 is retained; no fifth turn is fabricated.

The complete proof combines the classical geometric maximum-length theorem and chain embedding with an unbounded signed linking reduction, all810 exact length20 actions, and full edge/action comparisons on90,921 coaccessible states and261,810 edges at length30. Python, C++, two distinct backward-graph controls and fresh adversarial reconstructions reproduce full records. All43 original target files and their historical manifests are preserved.

The priority audit credits Matsumoto’s exact quotient presentation, Sato’s numerical spectrum, and Casson’s general crossing assertion reported by Elrifai–Morton. No first-priority claim or certification of historical novelty is made. The research note answers the exact original question decisively; the finite length30 certificate is verification of an older assertion.

A six-page preprint and complete source/verification ZIP are in draft_pr_descending_audit_20261002/audits/pr367_11000151/preprint. Three independent mathematical approach families, the root’s complete original and independent replays, and two fresh sequential preprint reviewers audit the proof and package. The first reviewer’s missing-second-control finding was repaired globally; the second review’s exact clearance and submission bindings are recorded in PUBLISHING_CLEARANCE.json before acceptance. Extensive AI use is disclosed. This is unrefereed and has not received external human peer review.

Primary question: https://www.math.uchicago.edu/~farb/papers/mcgbook.pdf, Wajnryb Section3, printed page126 of the linked online version. Accepted audit and final publication receipts are in draft_pr_descending_audit_20261002/audits/pr367_11000151. Zenodo publication and the explicitly requested tracker entry follow the verified package clearance; their actual identifiers are recorded in the publication subfolder.
